headword: {聖徳太子|しょうとくたいし}

definitions.explanation: A regent and politician of the Asuka period (574–622), credited with promoting Buddhism and Chinese culture in Japan. He was featured on Japanese banknotes for many years.

examples.japanese: {聖徳太子|しょうとくたいし}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{仏教|ぶっきょう}→仏教：11428_bukkyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{広|ひろ}めた→広める：02405_hiromeru⟧。
{聖徳太子|しょうとくたいし}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{十七条|じゅうしちじょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{憲法|けんぽう}→憲法：02744_kenpou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{定|さだ}めた→定める：10448_sadameru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}われている→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: Prince Shotoku is said to have established the Seventeen-Article Constitution.

examples.english: The portrait of Prince Shotoku used to appear on the ten-thousand-yen bill.

notes:
USAGE:
One of the most famous historical figures in Japan. Every Japanese person learns about {聖徳太子|しょうとくたいし} in school. He was featured on multiple denominations of Japanese banknotes from 1930 to 1986, and is associated with {法隆寺|ほうりゅうじ} temple in Nara.
